scope: Fixed-exposure, isolated CPU Filmic V7 tone and matrix gamut in spline v3; no production implementation yet

coverage.units: Source black/white EV; scene/display grey and display black/white percent; latitude and balance percent; unitless contrast and hardness
coverage.consumer: CPU Filmic V7 kernel via upstream committed data; parameter metadata and derived coefficients dumped
coverage.verification: synthetic: all 3x3 hard/soft/safe curve modes, default settings and manual hardness with custom grey/latitude/balance; exhaustive parameter edges and stage parity pending

coverage.units: Scene-linear Rec.2020 samples; saturation percent / 100, with pure branch points at -50 and +50 percent
coverage.consumer: Isolated CPU rendering with the original pre-division norm clamp and blend
coverage.verification: synthetic and both D0 cases: finite output and target bounds; per-branch RGB dumps and independent numeric parity pending

coverage.consumer: Isolated CPU Ych/chroma path and round-trip to work RGB; sRGB web-safe, P3, matching Rec.2020, and null export profile
coverage.verification: synthetic with all targets; D0 for sRGB and P3; target matrix bounds checked before colorout

coverage.units: display-referred work RGB through Lab D50 to target linear RGB, then encoded float SDR RGB
coverage.verification: Isolated upstream matrix-shaper functions checked via nominal D65 primary matrices and independent one-pass sRGB transfer, both built-in SDR profiles, synthetic and full-size D0. The LUT/extrapolation boundary is exercised; HDR, file encoding and mobile paths are not covered.

Pinned CPU Release plugins loaded by upstream headless runtime and executed on full-size D0, with the computed default hardness supplied to both paths. No OpenCL, full pixelpipe or production export was exercised. Difference counts and matched-input colorout results are in the native manifests; non-default native parameter and compiler parity remain pending.

Upstream auto-picking UI, optional wavelet reconstruction, legacy spline versions, proofing/Little CMS/HDR output paths, and FilmKit HDR/preview/product wiring are not claimed by this reference. Release license path and same-RAW production parity are pending.
